plan.purpose: User-directed shorter screen. Ten serial observations with shared bracketing controls on moving/firing Sky Force and standard Snakes. Reuse full V29 correctness acceptance. Supersedes remaining original 64-run plan; original 18 observations retained separately.
stopping_rules: No speed promotion from this exploratory pass.
Reject a clear loser if it is at least 10 percent slower than even the slower bracketing control on both routes.

Advance only a candidate at least 8 percent faster than the faster bracketing control on one route, with at most 10 percent loss versus the slower control on the other and Snakes remaining at least realtime. A gain of at least 20 percent may justify up to 15 percent loss on the other.
Other small, mixed or noisy outcomes stay unresolved and disabled; no automatic reruns. Any additional run must name a specific uncertainty.

Advancing candidates receive a prospectively declared reversed-order pass on BOTH routes, with fresh shared controls. Full relevant repeated four-route and live acceptance is reserved for a promising final combination.

from pathlib import Path
import json
s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-sky-performance');out=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1-sky-performance/src/tests/benchmark')
q=json.loads((s/'hotpath-v29-short-timings.json').read_text());assert len(q)==10
plan=json.loads((s/'hotpath-v29-short-plan.json').read_text());decisions=[]
for item in ['cache','outer','guard']:
 routes=[]
 for route in ['combat','standard']:
  rows=[x for x in q if x['route']==route];controls=[x for x in rows if x['build']=='control'];x=next(x for x in rows if x['experiment']==item)
  assert len(controls)==2 and len({y['instructions'] for y in rows})==1 and len({y['presentations'] for y in rows})==1
  fast=min(y['wall_seconds']for y in controls);slow=max(y['wall_seconds']for y in controls)
  routes.append({'route':route,'candidate_realtime':x['guest_seconds']/x['wall_seconds'],'control_realtime':[y['guest_seconds']/y['wall_seconds']for y in controls],'gain_vs_faster_control':100*(fast/x['wall_seconds']-1),'gain_vs_slower_control':100*(slow/x['wall_seconds']-1),'warmup_seconds':x['warmup_seconds'],'control_warmup_seconds':[y['warmup_seconds']for y in controls]})
 clear_loser=all(x['gain_vs_slower_control']<=-10 for x in routes)
 best=max(x['gain_vs_faster_control'] for x in routes);worst=min(x['gain_vs_slower_control'] for x in routes)
 promising=(best>=8 and worst>=-10 or best>=20 and worst>=-15) and routes[1]['candidate_realtime']>=1
 disposition='reject exploratory loser' if clear_loser else 'advance to reversed-order screen' if promising else 'unresolved; disabled; no automatic rerun'
 decisions.append({'item':item,'disposition':disposition,'routes':routes})
e={'plan':plan,'rows':q,'decisions':decisions,'reports':{x['name']:json.loads((s/x['name']/'report.json').read_text())for x in q},'host':{x['name']:(s/(x['name']+'-host.jsonl')).read_text()for x in q},'scripts':{n:(s/n).read_text()for n in ['screen_hotpath_short_v29.py','record_hotpath_short_v29.py']},'reused_acceptance':'3f2b4d5d7; frozen V29 runtime and paths unchanged','prior_partial_panel':'57212f1c9; original 18 observations retained independently','promotion':False}
(out/'HOTPATH_SHORT_SCREEN_EVIDENCE.json').write_text(json.dumps(e,indent=2))
lines=['# V29 short decision screen','','User-directed plan change after 18/64 original observations. Reuse accepted V29 correctness and frozen archive. This prospective ten-observation screen uses shared opening/closing controls on moving-and-firing Sky Force and standard Snakes. All runs are serial, with detailed counters and sampling disabled and original limits intact. Full startup cost and all samples remain.','','An exploratory result is not a promoted speed gain. The predeclared rules reject only clear two-game losers, leave small/noisy effects unresolved, and send promising candidates to a reversed-order pass on both routes with fresh controls. A large one-game gain may justify modest loss in the other.','','Verification-check specialization: prior complete 16-observation panel is mixed/unresolved and remains off. The initial stationary cache pair was -7.2%; it remains in the prior partial panel rather than being discarded.','','| Item | Route | Candidate realtime | Opening / closing control realtime | Gain vs faster / slower control | Candidate warmup seconds |','|---|---|---:|---|---|---:|']
for d in decisions:
 for x in d['routes']:lines.append(f"| {d['item']} | {x['route']} | {x['candidate_realtime']:.3f}x | {' / '.join(f'{v:.3f}x' for v in x['control_realtime'])} | {x['gain_vs_faster_control']:+.2f}% / {x['gain_vs_slower_control']:+.2f}% | {x['warmup_seconds']:.2f} |")
lines+=['','Dispositions:']+[f"- {d['item']}: {d['disposition']}."for d in decisions]
lines+=['','All four items have emitted-work evidence and correctness acceptance in HOTPATH_SPECIALIZATION_RESULTS.md. Combined selectable binary cost is +77,029 bytes (+0.696%); this screen does not isolate a trimmed production binary size. Realtime Sky Force remains the goal. No deployment or push.']
(out/'HOTPATH_SHORT_SCREEN_RESULTS.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
(s/'hotpath-v29-short-decisions.json').write_text(json.dumps(decisions,indent=2));print(json.dumps(decisions,indent=2))
